name: Yadavindra Gardens (Pinjore)
opening_hours: 7:00 AM - 9:30 PM daily (illuminated fountains in evening)
best_time: October to April (Mango Festival in July)
rules: Do not wade into fountain water channels
Toy train ride available inside lower garden terrace
visual_features: seven-tiered terraced Mughal pleasure garden with central waterway, fountains, and royal pavilions like Shish Mahal
description: Yadavindra Gardens, also known as Pinjore Gardens, is a historic 17th century garden located in Pinjore city of Panchkula district in the Indian state of Haryana. Panchkula city is nearby it. It is an example of the Mughal gardens architectural style, which was renovated by the Patiala dynasty Sikh rulers. The garden was built by Fidai Khan, a foster-brother to the Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb.
